Olivia Park: did a focused recurrence pass for Jun-Aug (90d). pulled signatures from postmortems, alert spikes, and SLA-violation tags. found 4 persistent clusters that keep coming up and a few infra blips. putting owners + quick mitigations below. full notebook: https://redwood-internal/notes/recurrence-jun-aug-2026

Hector Ruiz: drop the top signatures + counts so we can prioritize.

Olivia Park: quick table (from the query):

```
signature | incidents | pct_total
KV_MULTI_TENANT_THRASH | 20 | 26%
FALLBACK_CIRCUIT_FLIP | 13 | 17%
MODEL_SHARD_MISMATCH | 9 | 12%
AUTOSCALER_LATE_DOWN | 7 | 9%
other | 26 | 36%
```

Query used: `SELECT signature, count(*) as incidents, round(count(*)*100.0/(SELECT count(*) FROM incidents WHERE detected_at >= '2026-06-01'),1) as pct_total FROM incidents WHERE detected_at >= '2026-06-01' GROUP BY signature ORDER BY incidents DESC;`

Mei Tan: thanks. KV_MULTI_TENANT_THRASH looks like the long tail offender. i can own that. plan: (1) per-tenant eviction caps for hot prefixes, (2) adaptive admission for massive write bursts, (3) add eviction-latency SLO + alert. risk: Dedicated p95. i'll gate behind a feature flag and include a one-click revert. ETA 18 days (2026-09-05).

Greg Lawson: i'll take FALLBACK_CIRCUIT_FLIP. hypothesis: when a Dedicated pool loses capacity we roll back to a smaller model and the control-plane aggressively retries, triggering oscillation. plan: add circuit-breaker with exponential cooldown and per-pool fallback thresholds + console rule to pause rollouts if fallback rate > 6% for 5m. will also add an eval set for semantic regressions in canaries. ETA 12 days.

Hector Ruiz: MODEL_SHARD_MISMATCH—i'll coordinate with model-onboard. suspect mismatched dtype/shape across sharded checkpoints for some third-party weights. remediation: add schema validation + a lightweight shard-read checker on import, and run a catalog scan. ETA 10 days.

Olivia Park: great. i'll create epic INC-4999 and seed tickets. incidents-bot, please create epic INC-4999: "Recurrence followups Jun-Aug 2026" with labels recurrence-review, action-required.

incidents-bot: Created epic INC-4999: "Recurrence followups Jun-Aug 2026" labels: recurrence-review, action-required. https://jira.local/browse/INC-4999

Mei Tan: action items (to add to INC-4999):
- Mei Tan — per-tenant eviction caps + admission control + eviction-latency dashboard + rollback doc — due 2026-09-05
- Greg Lawson — fallback circuit-breaker + per-pool thresholds + canary evals + emergency bypass for security patches — due 2026-08-30
- Hector Ruiz — model shard schema validator + catalog scan + onboarding test — scan done by 2026-08-20, fixes by 2026-09-01
- Platform SRE — autoscaler late-down probe + safety-net policy (grace window and soft-queue) — due 2026-08-28
- Olivia Park — recurrence dashboard tiles + weekly digest to owners — due 2026-08-18

Greg Lawson: risk note: fallback breakers must not block urgent hotfix rollouts. adding manual approval and audit trail for bypass. also will run a canary with the semantic eval set before enabling.

Hector Ruiz: for the catalog scan i'll run a parallel job that flags models with mismatched shard shapes and create an ASAP ticket list. will post progress in the epic.

Mei Tan: about autoscaler late-downs  i've noticed a pattern where scale-downs happen before KV workloads drain, causing sudden cache pressure. propose small change: extend node drain timeout by default for pools with high cache residency and add a soft admission throttle during drains.

Olivia Park: good idea  add that as a Platform SRE action. i'll update the epic.

incidents-bot: Added tickets to INC-4999 and assigned labels. https://jira.local/browse/INC-4999

Hector Ruiz: i'll coordinate with model-onboard and assign specific owners for shard fixes by EOD.

Mei Tan: will open a feature-flag PR for eviction caps this week and include load test configs (2x observed peak QPS, collect p50/p95/p99 and cache hit ratio).

Greg Lawson: i'll draft the fallback breaker PR and add canary gating rules to the console; will include fallback-rate metric and an alert policy.

Olivia Park: scheduling a 30m triage for next Tue 2026-08-25 16:00 UTC to review PRs and blockers. if anyone needs an earlier unblock, ping here. :thumbsup:

incidents-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Triage: INC-4999 sync" on 2026-08-25 16:00 UTC.
